title: Health events reported by US adults aged ≥ 60 years who received a respiratory syncytial virus vaccine alone or with other vaccines
abstract: Data concerning reactogenicity of RSV vaccines when administered with other vaccines are limited. During October 20, 2023-December 29, 2024, 18,252 V-safe participants aged ≥60 years completed a voluntary survey during the week after RSV vaccination. Of these, 11,333 (62%) received a Pfizer, GSK, or Moderna RSV vaccine alone and 6919 (38%) received an RSV vaccine with at least one other vaccine in the same week. Compared with participants who received Pfizer vaccine alone, those who received Pfizer with another vaccine were more likely to report injection site symptoms. Those who received GSK vaccine, either alone or with another vaccine, were more likely to report symptoms, but risk did not vary by coadministration status. Risk of symptoms after Moderna vaccination was similar to risk after Pfizer. These data can be used to advise patients about expected reactions after vaccination with RSV alone or with other vaccines.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on health events reported by US adults aged ≥ 60 years who received a respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine alone or with other vaccines. The central question is to evaluate the reactogenicity and safety of RSV vaccines in this population when administered alone or in combination with other vaccines.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes data from a voluntary survey of 18,252 V-safe participants aged ≥60 years who completed the survey during the week after RSV vaccination, between October 20, 2023, and December 29, 2024. The study design is observational, and the review method involves analyzing self-reported symptoms following vaccination.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the risk of symptoms after Moderna vaccination is similar to that after Pfizer. However, for the GSK vaccine, the risk of symptoms was higher regardless of whether it was administered alone or with another vaccine. There is no clear evidence of varying risk based on coadministration status for GSK.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that data concerning the reactogenicity of RSV vaccines when administered with other vaccines are limited. This lack of data creates uncertainty about the safety of coadministration in some cases.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: These data can be used to advise patients about expected reactions after vaccination with RSV alone or with other vaccines. The findings suggest the need for further research to clarify the reactogenicity of RSV vaccines when coadministered with other vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines health events reported by US adults aged ≥60 years following RSV vaccination, either alone or with other vaccines. It highlights that data on reactogenicity with coadministered vaccines are limited. The study found that participants receiving the Pfizer vaccine with another vaccine were more likely to report injection site symptoms compared to those receiving Pfizer alone. For the GSK vaccine, symptom risk was higher regardless of coadministration status, while Moderna vaccination showed similar symptom risk to Pfizer. These findings can inform patient counseling about expected reactions but underscore the need for more research on coadministration effects.

title: Differences in patient attitudes on respiratory syncytial virus immunization among Canadian jurisdictions with and without publicly funded universal nirsevimab programs
abstract: BACKGROUND: In 2024, Canada introduced two strategies to prevent severe infant RSV infection: maternal vaccine (RSVpreF) and infant monoclonal antibody (nirsevimab). Although Canadian guidelines recommended universal seasonal nirsevimab, implementation varied across provinces/territories. We compared attitudes and preferences towards RSV immunization in jurisdictions with and without publicly funded universal nirsevimab programs. METHODS: Between November 2024 and March 2025, we conducted a national prospective cohort study recruiting pregnant or recently pregnant participants through social media. Participants completed a baseline survey, with follow-up at 3 and 6 months postpartum. Surveys collected demographic data, obstetrical outcomes, reported receipt of immunization products, and attitudes towards RSVpreF and nirsevimab, including perceived barriers. Participants were analyzed by residence in provinces/territories with versus without universal nirsevimab programs. RESULTS: Among 1008 participants included in the analysis, 40.6% resided in jurisdictions with funded universal nirsevimab programs. If both immunization products were free and available, in jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab, 78.5% would accept nirsevimab, while 72.4% would accept RSVpreF. In provinces without funded nirsevimab programs, 73.9% of participants would accept nirsevimab with an 89.8% acceptance rate for RSVpreF (p < 0.001). In jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab programs, nirsevimab was perceived as more beneficial (p < 0.001) and more effective (p = 0.02) at preventing RSV disease than RSVpreF. Approximately 96% of participants agreed that the decision to obtain RSVpreF was up to them, however, fewer felt the same about nirsevimab (84.6%). When ranking vaccines in pregnancy, 43.9% of participants ranked Tdap as their top priority, while 21% ranked RSV vaccination first. Tdap was ranked higher than RSVpreF by 60.5% of participants, with no significant differences between jurisdictions. CONCLUSIONS: During the 2024/2025 RSV season, preferences between RSVpreF and nirsevimab were associated with provincial/territorial public funding for infant monoclonal antibodies. As RSV immunoprophylaxis programs evolve, policymakers should recognize that funding decisions can influence public attitudes and preferences towards available immunization products.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines differences in patient attitudes toward respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) immunization in Canadian jurisdictions with and without publicly funded universal nirsevimab programs. The target is RSV immunization, specifically comparing attitudes toward two products: maternal vaccine (RSVpreF) and infant monoclonal antibody (nirsevimab). The study focuses on pregnant or recently pregnant participants and their willingness to accept these immunization strategies based on jurisdictional funding policies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a national prospective cohort study conducted between November 2024 and March 2025, recruiting pregnant or recently pregnant participants through social media. Participants completed a baseline survey and follow-up at 3 and 6 months postpartum. The study analyzed data by residence in provinces/territories with versus without universal nirsevimab programs. The evidence includes demographic data, obstetrical outcomes, reported receipt of immunization products, and attitudes toward RSVpreF and nirsevimab, including perceived barriers.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that in jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab programs, 78.5% of participants would accept nirsevimab, while 72.4% would accept RSVpreF. In provinces without funded nirsevimab programs, 73.9% would accept nirsevimab, and 89.8% would accept RSVpreF (p < 0.001). Participants in jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab programs perceived nirsevimab as more beneficial (p < 0.001) and more effective (p = 0.02) at preventing RSV disease than RSVpreF. Additionally, 96% of participants agreed that the decision to obtain RSVpreF was up to them, but fewer felt the same about nirsevimab (84.6%).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study does not report on the reasons behind the differences in acceptance rates between jurisdictions with and without universal nirsevimab programs. It also does not explore the impact of other factors, such as healthcare access, socioeconomic status, or health literacy, on immunization preferences. Furthermore, the review does not provide information on the long-term effects of these immunization strategies or their effectiveness in reducing RSV-related morbidity and mortality.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that public funding for infant monoclonal antibodies like nirsevimab can influence patient attitudes and preferences toward RSV immunization. Policymakers should consider these preferences when designing immunization programs and should prioritize research into the factors that affect acceptance rates, such as healthcare access, health literacy, and socioeconomic status. Additionally, further studies are needed to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of these strategies in reducing RSV-related disease burden.

analysis.summary_en: This review compares patient attitudes toward RSV immunization in Canadian jurisdictions with and without publicly funded universal nirsevimab programs. It highlights that acceptance rates for nirsevimab and RSVpreF vary by jurisdiction, with higher acceptance for RSVpreF in areas without nirsevimab funding. Participants in jurisdictions with nirsevimab programs perceived it as more beneficial and effective than RSVpreF. The study underscores the importance of public funding in shaping immunization preferences and suggests the need for further research into factors influencing acceptance and the long-term effectiveness of these strategies.

title_zh: 加拿大司法管辖区有和没有公共资助的通用 呼吸道合胞病毒 计划时患者对 呼吸道合胞病毒 免疫的态度差异
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: In 2024, Canada introduced two strategies to prevent severe infant RSV infection: maternal vaccine (RSVpreF) and infant monoclonal antibody (nirsevimab). Although Canadian guidelines recommended universal seasonal nirsevimab, implementation varied across provinces/territories. We compared attitudes and preferences towards RSV immunization in jurisdictions with and without publicly funded universal nirsevimab programs. METHODS: Between November 2024 and March 2025, we conducted a national prospective cohort study recruiting pregnant or recently pregnant participants through social media. Participants completed a baseline survey, with follow-up at 3 and 6 months postpartum. Surveys collected demographic data, obstetrical outcomes, reported receipt of immunization products, and attitudes towards RSVpreF and nirsevimab, including perceived barriers. Participants were analyzed by residence in provinces/territories with versus without universal nirsevimab programs. RESULTS: Among 1008 participants included in the analysis, 40.6% resided in jurisdictions with funded universal nirsevimab programs. If both immunization products were free and available, in jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab, 78.5% would accept nirsevimab, while 72.4% would accept RSVpreF. In provinces without funded nirsevimab programs, 73.9% of participants would accept nirsevimab with an 89.8% acceptance rate for RSVpreF (p < 0.001). In jurisdictions with universal nirsevimab programs, nirsevimab was perceived as more beneficial (p < 0.001) and more effective (p = 0.02) at preventing RSV disease than RSVpreF. Approximately 96% of participants agreed that the decision to obtain RSVpreF was up to them, however, fewer felt the same about nirsevimab (84.6%). When ranking vaccines in pregnancy, 43.9% of participants ranked Tdap as their top priority, while 21% ranked RSV vaccination first. Tdap was ranked higher than RSVpreF by 60.5% of participants, with no significant differences between jurisdictions. CONCLUSIONS: During the 2024/2025 RSV season, preferences between RSVpreF and nirsevimab were associated with provincial/territorial public funding for infant monoclonal antibodies. As RSV immunoprophylaxis programs evolve, policymakers should recognize that funding decisions can influence public attitudes and preferences towards available immunization products.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该评价调查了加拿大司法管辖区有和没有公共资助的通用 呼吸道合胞病毒 计划的患者对 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 免疫的态度差异。目标是 RSV 免疫,具体比较对两种产品的态度:母体 疫苗 (RSVpreF) 和婴儿单克隆抗体 (尼塞韦单抗)。该研究的重点是怀孕或最近怀孕的参与者以及他们接受这些基于司法管辖区资助政策的免疫策略的意愿。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查基于 2024 年 11 月至 2025 年 3 月期间进行的一项全国前瞻性 队列研究 研究,通过社交媒体招募怀孕或最近怀孕的参与者。参与者在产后 3 个月和 6 个月完成基线调查和随访。该研究按居住在有和没有通用 尼塞韦单抗 计划的省份/地区分析了数据。证据包括人口统计数据、产科结果、报告的免疫产品接收情况以及对 RSVpreF 和 尼塞韦单抗 的态度,包括感知到的障碍。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,在具有通用 尼塞韦单抗 计划的司法管辖区,78.5% 的参与者会接受 尼塞韦单抗,而 72.4% 的参与者会接受 RSVpreF。在没有资助 尼塞韦单抗 项目的省份,73.9% 的人会接受 尼塞韦单抗,89.8% 的人会接受 RSVpreF (p < 0.001)。拥有通用 尼塞韦单抗 计划的辖区的参与者认为 尼塞韦单抗 在预防 RSV 疾病方面比 RSVpreF 更有益(p < 0.001)且更有效(p = 0.02)。此外,96% 的参与者同意获得 RSVpreF 的决定取决于他们,但对 尼塞韦单抗 持相同看法的人较少 (84.6%)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究没有报告有和没有通用 尼塞韦单抗 计划的司法管辖区之间接受率差异背后的原因。它还没有探讨其他因素(例如医疗保健获取、社会经济地位或健康素养)对免疫偏好的影响。此外,该综述没有提供有关这些免疫策略的长期影响或其​​在降低 RSV 相关发病率和 死亡率 方面的有效性的信息。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,对 尼塞韦单抗 等婴儿单克隆抗体的公共资助可以影响患者对 RSV 免疫的态度和偏好。政策制定者在设计免疫规划时应考虑这些偏好,并应优先研究影响接受率的因素,例如医疗保健、健康素养和社会经济地位。此外,还需要进一步的研究来评估这些策略在减少 RSV 相关疾病负担方面的长期有效性。

title: Maternal respiratory syncytial virus vaccination: A systematic review and meta-analysis of determinants of vaccine acceptability and uptake
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination has potential to prevent infant respiratory morbidity. We identified sociodemographic factors influencing the acceptability and uptake of RSV vaccination among pregnant individuals. METHODS: We carried out a systematic review and meta-analysis of sociodemographic factors associated with maternal RSV vaccination behavior. We searched MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Web of Science for observational studies of RSV vaccination in pregnant women published before September 10, 2025. We included articles that examined how maternal race/ethnicity, education, employment, age, and marital status were related to RSV vaccine intention and uptake. We performed a meta-analysis using random effects models with inverse-variance weighting to estimate pooled odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) for the association between sociodemographic factors and RSV vaccination intention and uptake. RESULTS: Seventeen studies comprising 15,275 individuals met inclusion criteria. Black race was the strongest determinant of vaccination behavior during pregnancy, followed by socioeconomic factors. In meta-analysis, Black race was associated with more than 50% lower odds of RSV vaccine uptake compared with White race (OR 0.43, 95% CI 0.32-0.57; 6 studies). Low educational attainment (OR 0.59, 95% CI 0.45-0.76; 8 studies) and unemployment (OR 0.73, 95% CI 0.56-0.96; 7 studies) were associated with >20% less intention to be vaccinated compared with higher education or employment. Maternal age and marital status were not associated with RSV vaccination intention. CONCLUSION: Black patients and patients from low socioeconomic backgrounds should be a primary focus of obstetric RSV vaccination efforts.

abstract_original: OBJECTIVE: Maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination has potential to prevent infant respiratory morbidity. We identified sociodemographic factors influencing the acceptability and uptake of RSV vaccination among pregnant individuals. METHODS: We carried out a systematic review and meta-analysis of sociodemographic factors associated with maternal RSV vaccination behavior. We searched MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Web of Science for observational studies of RSV vaccination in pregnant women published before September 10, 2025. We included articles that examined how maternal race/ethnicity, education, employment, age, and marital status were related to RSV vaccine intention and uptake. We performed a meta-analysis using random effects models with inverse-variance weighting to estimate pooled odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) for the association between sociodemographic factors and RSV vaccination intention and uptake. RESULTS: Seventeen studies comprising 15,275 individuals met inclusion criteria. Black race was the strongest determinant of vaccination behavior during pregnancy, followed by socioeconomic factors. In meta-analysis, Black race was associated with more than 50% lower odds of RSV vaccine uptake compared with White race (OR 0.43, 95% CI 0.32-0.57; 6 studies). Low educational attainment (OR 0.59, 95% CI 0.45-0.76; 8 studies) and unemployment (OR 0.73, 95% CI 0.56-0.96; 7 studies) were associated with >20% less intention to be vaccinated compared with higher education or employment. Maternal age and marital status were not associated with RSV vaccination intention. CONCLUSION: Black patients and patients from low socioeconomic backgrounds should be a primary focus of obstetric RSV vaccination efforts.

title: Enhanced respiratory syncytial virus surveillance of young children admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, 2019-2023.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: In this study, we aimed to comprehensively describe the clinical characteristics, management and outcomes of children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (SCHN), determine the full burden of severe disease and identify population-specific risk factors for intensive care unit (ICU) admission. STUDY TYPE: Multi-centre, retrospective cohort study conducted over 5 years. METHODS: The study was conducted at two tertiary paediatric hospitals in metropolitan New South Wales, Australia, before implementation of government-funded immunisation programs against RSV in children. Participants were children aged <2 years hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV from 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2023, comprising all ICU admitted, and a random sample of non-ICU admitted patients. The main outcome measures were characteristics and incidence rate of RSV hospitalisations and ICU admissions among children aged <2 years. RESULTS: Over a 5-year period, 4414 children were hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV, of whom 11.3% (499/4414) were admitted to ICU. The median age was younger in the ICU cohort (n = 499) compared with the non-ICU sample (n = 1000; 3.3 vs 7.1 months, P < 0.0001). Factors associated with higher odds of ICU admission in multivariate logistic regression were decreasing month of age (OR 1.10, 95% CI 1.06-1.11), prematurity (OR 2.17, 95% CI 1.61-2.91), Indigenous identity (OR 4.10, 95% CI 2.30-7.56) and cardiac disease (OR 3.39, 95% CI 2.06-5.70). The average hospitalisation incidence rate was 1615 per 100,000 (95% CI 1565-1666), with higher rates among children aged <1 year, 2141 per 100,000 (95% CI 2061-2224) compared with those aged 1-2 years, 1088 per 100,000 (95% CI 1030-1148). CONCLUSIONS: RSV immunisation programs are expected to substantially reduce the burden of hospitalisation among Australian children in their first year of life. Children who are Indigenous, were born prematurely or have heart disease are at greatest risk of severe disease and may benefit from extended preventative programs.

title_zh: 2019-2023 年悉尼儿童医院网络收治的幼儿的增强型 呼吸道合胞病毒 监测。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: In this study, we aimed to comprehensively describe the clinical characteristics, management and outcomes of children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (SCHN), determine the full burden of severe disease and identify population-specific risk factors for intensive care unit (ICU) admission. STUDY TYPE: Multi-centre, retrospective cohort study conducted over 5 years. METHODS: The study was conducted at two tertiary paediatric hospitals in metropolitan New South Wales, Australia, before implementation of government-funded immunisation programs against RSV in children. Participants were children aged <2 years hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV from 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2023, comprising all ICU admitted, and a random sample of non-ICU admitted patients. The main outcome measures were characteristics and incidence rate of RSV hospitalisations and ICU admissions among children aged <2 years. RESULTS: Over a 5-year period, 4414 children were hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV, of whom 11.3% (499/4414) were admitted to ICU. The median age was younger in the ICU cohort (n = 499) compared with the non-ICU sample (n = 1000; 3.3 vs 7.1 months, P < 0.0001). Factors associated with higher odds of ICU admission in multivariate logistic regression were decreasing month of age (OR 1.10, 95% CI 1.06-1.11), prematurity (OR 2.17, 95% CI 1.61-2.91), Indigenous identity (OR 4.10, 95% CI 2.30-7.56) and cardiac disease (OR 3.39, 95% CI 2.06-5.70). The average hospitalisation incidence rate was 1615 per 100,000 (95% CI 1565-1666), with higher rates among children aged <1 year, 2141 per 100,000 (95% CI 2061-2224) compared with those aged 1-2 years, 1088 per 100,000 (95% CI 1030-1148). CONCLUSIONS: RSV immunisation programs are expected to substantially reduce the burden of hospitalisation among Australian children in their first year of life. Children who are Indigenous, were born prematurely or have heart disease are at greatest risk of severe disease and may benefit from extended preventative programs.

title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infection After Allogeneic Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: Outcomes in a 15‐Year Single‐Center Cohort
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a frequent and potentially severe complication after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (allo‐HCT). We describe outcomes in a 15‐year single‐center cohort. Methods All allo‐HCT recipients with PCR‐confirmed RSV infection at Karolinska University Hospital (January 2010–April 2024) were analyzed retrospectively. Outcomes were evaluated by time from HCT; ribavirin analyses were restricted to patients with upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) at presentation, at risk of progression to lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI). Results Among 102 patients, 44 (43%) were diagnosed more than 1 year after HCT. Overall, 28 (27%) developed LRTI, including eight who progressed from URTI. RSV‐associated mortality was 2/102 (2.0%); ICU admission occurred in 6/102 (5.9%). Progression from URTI to LRTI was more frequent when RSV was diagnosed within 30 days of HCT than later (4/11 [36%] vs. 4/71 [5.6%]; p = 0.010). Of 43 patients given ribavirin (predominantly oral), 31 were treated at the URTI stage; 5/31 (16%) progressed after initiation versus 2/51 (3.9%) untreated ( p = 0.098). CRP was higher in LRTI than in URTI alone (median 50 vs. 17 mg/L; p = 0.011), but bacterial co‐infection was also more frequent (32% vs. Conclusion RSV‐associated mortality after allo‐HCT was low, but morbidity was prolonged, particularly early after transplantation. Findings should be interpreted cautiously given the late occurrence of RSV in many patients and differences in diagnostics and transplant practice compared with historical cohorts. This retrospective study did not show a protective effect of oral ribavirin. Prospective studies of prevention and treatment, including RSV vaccination, are warranted.

title: Admission serum GDF-15 and soluble CD8A in pediatric RSV infection: an exploratory cross-sectional study
abstract: AIMS: To compare growth differentiation factor-15 (GDF-15) and soluble CD8-alpha (sCD8A) between children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection and controls, and to examine whether GDF-15 is associated with length of hospital stay. PATIENTS & METHODS: Thirty-two children hospitalized with confirmed RSV infection and 14 outpatient controls of similar age without acute illness were enrolled. Serum GDF-15 and sCD8A were measured by ELISA. Associations were assessed by Spearman correlation and Mann-Whitney U tests; Poisson regression adjusted for age, C-reactive protein (CRP) and respiratory support served as a sensitivity analysis. Remaining analyses were exploratory and uncorrected for multiplicity. RESULTS: Neither marker differed between patients and controls. Among patients, GDF-15 correlated with length of stay (r = .516, 95% CI .20-.73, p = .002); adjusted estimates were model dependent (Poisson incidence rate ratio 1.19, 95% CI 1.05-1.34; log-linear model p = .114). sCD8A correlated weakly and inversely with CRP (r = -.368, p = .038) and red cell distribution width (r = -.394, p = .026). CONCLUSION: Higher admission GDF-15 was associated with longer hospitalization; severity was not assessed with a validated measure. These exploratory associations do not establish prognostic value and require confirmation in larger prospective cohorts.

title: Age-Specific Prevalence of Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) IgG antibodies to inform the toddler vaccination window in coastal Kenya: Observations during and after the COVID -19 pandemic
abstract: Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of lower respiratory tract infection in infants and young children. Determining the appropriate age for RSV vaccination requires consideration of age-specific patterns of maternal antibody waning and infection risk. However, disruptions in RSV circulation during the COVID-19 pandemic may have altered these patterns. Reassessment of vaccination timing is essential to inform the evaluation and implementation of a childhood RSV vaccine. Methods This study utilised 760 serum samples, collected from children admitted to the paediatric ward of Kilifi County Referral Hospital (KCRH), between January 2020 and December 2023, regardless of diagnosis. RSV-specific IgG antibody titers in the serum samples were quantified by indirect Enzyme- Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA). Age-specific seroprevalence was estimated and compared with previously reported pre-pandemic estimates, and catalytic modelling was used to estimate the vaccination window during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Results Participants had a median age of 11 months (IQR 5–24), and 79.6% (95% CI: 76.7–82.5) were seropositive. Seroprevalence was 100% in children 3 years. Maternal antibodies were estimated to wane at a rate of 1.73 per year (95% CI 1.60–2.25), and the force of infection (FOI) at 0–32 months was 1.75 per person-year (95% CI 1.54–2.04) while that at >32–144 months was 0.01 per person-year (95% CI 0.01–0.29). Estimated average age at primary infection was 17.4 months (95% CI 13.5–19.0), and optimal vaccination age was 8.7 months (95% CI 7.2–9.2). Conclusion Despite the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic on RSV transmission patterns and age-specific seroprevalence, the estimated optimal vaccination window remained largely unchanged, with a slight shift towards the older age group.

Serum samples from 760 children admitted to the paediatric ward of Kilifi County Referral Hospital between January 2020 and December 2023 were tested for RSV-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA. The results indicated that the average age at primary infection was 17.4 months, and the optimal vaccination age was estimated at 8.7 months. The findings suggest that the optimal age for RSV vaccination is around 8.7 months, which could inform future vaccine implementation strategies. The study's methods included catalytic modelling to estimate the vaccination window, and the results were based on seroprevalence data. The evidence strength is high, as the study used a large sample size and robust statistical methods.

title: Under pressure: lessons learnt from rapid implementation of the respiratory syncytial virus maternal vaccine and infant nirsevimab in Sydney, Australia.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To share lessons learnt from the Sydney Local Health District (SLHD) rollout of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevention products, and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. TYPE OF SERVICE: Rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and the injectable, long-acting monoclonal antibody nirsevimab for newborn infants to protect them from RSV infection and hospitalisation. METHODS: Deidentified summary data from the electronic medical record on RSV immunisation status in two SLHD maternity hospitals were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used as a lens to reflect on the rollout process. RESULTS: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in two SLHD hospitals improved from 4% in the first month of rollout (February 2025) to a range of 70-74% from June to September 2025. As antenatal coverage improved, the number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reason for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved as the rollout progressed. LESSONS LEARNT: Engaging multidisciplinary leaders and clinicians is critical for a coordinated response and program rollout success. Leveraging existing education structures, staff meetings and using online prerecording can optimise clinician education. New programs take time to embed into routine clinical practice, and programs that involve delivering multiple immunisation products for distinct groups require clear messaging and systemic safeguards to prevent errors. Integrating immunisation into medical record workflows as standard practice can support program adoption and uptake.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to share lessons from the rapid implementation of RSV prevention products and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. The research addresses the need for effective strategies to improve RSV vaccine and nirsevimab adoption in clinical settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and nirsevimab for newborn infants in two maternity hospitals within the Sydney Local Health District. It analysed immunisation status data from February 2025 to September 2025.
analysis.methods: Deidentified summary data from electronic medical records were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used to evaluate the rollout process.
analysis.main_results: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in the two hospitals increased from 4% in the first month of rollout to 70-74% from June to September 2025. The number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased as antenatal coverage improved. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reasons for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence that coordinated efforts and clear messaging are essential for successful program rollout. The study highlights the importance of integrating immunisation into clinical workflows to support program adoption.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform strategies for improving immunisation uptake for RSV prevention products in maternity settings. They also provide insights into the challenges of implementing new vaccines and monoclonal antibodies in routine clinical practice.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on deidentified summary data and the lack of recorded reasons for nirsevimab refusal. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the analysis and the absence of control groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the rollout of the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) maternal vaccine and the monoclonal antibody nirsevimab in two maternity hospitals in Sydney, Australia. It reports that RSV vaccination coverage among mothers improved significantly from 4% in February 2025 to 70-74% by September 2025. The number of infants requiring nirsevimab decreased as maternal coverage increased, while 36% of eligible newborns declined the treatment without recorded reasons. The authors highlight the importance of multidisciplinary engagement, leveraging existing education structures, and integrating immunisation into medical record workflows for successful program adoption. The study's findings suggest that clear messaging and systemic safeguards are critical for implementing multiple immunisation products in clinical practice. However, the study is limited by its observational design and lack of detailed refusal data, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及在悉尼地方卫生区的两家妇产医院针对新生儿推出 RSV 孕产妇 疫苗 和 尼塞韦单抗。它分析了 2025 年 2 月至 2025 年 9 月的免疫状况数据。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明协调一致的努力和清晰的信息对于项目的成功推出至关重要。该研究强调了将免疫接种纳入临床工作流程以支持计划采用的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为提高产妇环境中 RSV 预防产品免疫接种的策略提供参考。他们还深入探讨了在常规临床实践中实施新的 疫苗 和单克隆抗体所面临的挑战。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于它依赖于去识别化的汇总数据,并且缺乏 尼塞韦单抗 拒绝的记录原因。由于分析的观察性质和缺乏对照组,证据的强度中等。

title: Systemic Manifestations of RSV-Bronchiolitis Beyond the Lungs
abstract: Objective: To evaluate the extrapulmonary manifestations in infants and young children admitted with PCR- confirmed RSV bronchiolitis and to examine their relationship with clinical acuity and in-hospital outcomes. Methodology: A prospective observational study was carried out in the Department of Pediatrics, Federal Government Polyclinic Hospital, Islamabad from November 2025 to February 2026. in children aged 1-48 months with PCR-confirmed RSV bronchiolitis. Patients with other viral or bacterial co-infection or chronic medical conditions were excluded. They were assessed for neurological, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and metabolic manifestations during hospitalization. The demographic data, clinical observations, laboratory values, level of care, respiratory support, the length of hospital stay, and outcomes were documented. Because a validated bronchiolitis severity score was not prospectively recorded, level of care was used as a pragmatic measure of clinical acuity; ward admission represented lower-acuity care and HDU/ICU admission higher-acuity care. The analysis of data was performed in SPSS 24, and the p-value < 0.05 was considered significant. Results: A total of 123 pediatric patients with RSV-bronchiolitis were enrolled. Extrapulmonary findings were observed with metabolic manifestations in 29.3% patients followed by gastrointestinal(27.6%), neurological(26.7%) and cardiovascular[A1] [D2] [HN3] (21%) involvement. Metabolic manifestations included hypocalcemia(15.4%), hyponatremia(9.8%), hypokalemia(8.1%), hyperkalemia(7.3%) and hypernatremia(0.8%). Gastrointestinal involvement was in the form of diarrhea(11%) and vomiting(9%). Neurological problems included seizures(18%) and altered level of consciousness(8%). Cardiovascular manifestations included myocarditis(11%), murmur(9%) and tachycardia(1%). The mean duration of hospital stay was 6.2±3.7 days. The average hospital stay was significantly longer among patients with cardiac manifestations, including tachycardia (9.14±6.6 days), murmurs (6.18±3.0 days), and myocarditis (7.0±0.0 days), compared with those without cardiac involvement (5.8±3.0 days; p=0.020). However, no significant difference in hospital stay was observed in patients with gastrointestinal (p=0.127) and neurological manifestations (p=0.127). In severity-stratified analysis, any extrapulmonary manifestation occurred in 59.6% of ward patients and 70.6% of HDU/ICU patients (p=0.302); no individual system showed a statistically significant difference between the two groups. Amongst the six recorded deaths, 50% of patients had associated metabolic derangements. Conclusion: RSV bronchiolitis demonstrates substantial multisystem involvement in hospitalized children with PCR-confirmed RSV bronchiolitis which were not confined to patients requiring HDU/ICU care. Cardiovascular involvement was associated with a longer hospital stay, while no statistically significant severity-based difference was demonstrated for individual extrapulmonary systems. Early recognition of these extrapulmonary manifestations is crucial to improve clinical outcome and optimize treatment.

title_zh: RSV-毛细支气管炎 肺部以外的全身表现
source_body_en: Objective: To evaluate the extrapulmonary manifestations in infants and young children admitted with PCR- confirmed RSV bronchiolitis and to examine their relationship with clinical acuity and in-hospital outcomes. Methodology: A prospective observational study was carried out in the Department of Pediatrics, Federal Government Polyclinic Hospital, Islamabad from November 2025 to February 2026. in children aged 1-48 months with PCR-confirmed RSV bronchiolitis. Patients with other viral or bacterial co-infection or chronic medical conditions were excluded. They were assessed for neurological, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and metabolic manifestations during hospitalization. The demographic data, clinical observations, laboratory values, level of care, respiratory support, the length of hospital stay, and outcomes were documented. Because a validated bronchiolitis severity score was not prospectively recorded, level of care was used as a pragmatic measure of clinical acuity; ward admission represented lower-acuity care and HDU/ICU admission higher-acuity care. The analysis of data was performed in SPSS 24, and the p-value < 0.05 was considered significant. Results: A total of 123 pediatric patients with RSV-bronchiolitis were enrolled. Extrapulmonary findings were observed with metabolic manifestations in 29.3% patients followed by gastrointestinal(27.6%), neurological(26.7%) and cardiovascular[A1] [D2] [HN3] (21%) involvement. Metabolic manifestations included hypocalcemia(15.4%), hyponatremia(9.8%), hypokalemia(8.1%), hyperkalemia(7.3%) and hypernatremia(0.8%). Gastrointestinal involvement was in the form of diarrhea(11%) and vomiting(9%). Neurological problems included seizures(18%) and altered level of consciousness(8%). Cardiovascular manifestations included myocarditis(11%), murmur(9%) and tachycardia(1%). The mean duration of hospital stay was 6.2±3.7 days. The average hospital stay was significantly longer among patients with cardiac manifestations, including tachycardia (9.14±6.6 days), murmurs (6.18±3.0 days), and myocarditis (7.0±0.0 days), compared with those without cardiac involvement (5.8±3.0 days; p=0.020). However, no significant difference in hospital stay was observed in patients with gastrointestinal (p=0.127) and neurological manifestations (p=0.127). In severity-stratified analysis, any extrapulmonary manifestation occurred in 59.6% of ward patients and 70.6% of HDU/ICU patients (p=0.302); no individual system showed a statistically significant difference between the two groups. Amongst the six recorded deaths, 50% of patients had associated metabolic derangements. Conclusion: RSV bronchiolitis demonstrates substantial multisystem involvement in hospitalized children with PCR-confirmed RSV bronchiolitis which were not confined to patients requiring HDU/ICU care. Cardiovascular involvement was associated with a longer hospital stay, while no statistically significant severity-based difference was demonstrated for individual extrapulmonary systems. Early recognition of these extrapulmonary manifestations is crucial to improve clinical outcome and optimize treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的:评估 PCR 确诊的 RSV 毛细支气管炎 婴幼儿的肺外表现,并探讨其与临床病情和院内结局的关系。方法:2025 年 11 月至 2026 年 2 月,在伊斯兰堡联邦政府综合医院儿科对 PCR 确诊的 RSV 毛细支气管炎 的 1-48 个月儿童进行了一项前瞻性观察性研究。患有其他病毒或细菌合并感染或慢性疾病的患者被排除在外。他们在住院期间接受了神经、心血管、胃肠道和代谢表现的评估。记录了人口统计数据、临床观察、实验室值、护理水平、呼吸支持、住院时间和结果。由于未前瞻性记录经过验证的 毛细支气管炎 严重程度评分,因此护理水平被用作临床敏锐度的实用衡量标准;入院代表低危重护理,HDU/ICU 入院代表高危重护理。数据分析在SPSS 24中进行,p值<0.05被认为是显着的。结果:共有 123 名 RSV-毛细支气管炎 儿童患者入组。29.3% 的患者观察到肺外表现,包括代谢表现,其次是胃肠道 (27.6%)、神经系统 (26.7%) 和心血管[A1] [D2] [HN3] (21%) 受累。代谢表现包括低钙血症(15.4%)、低钠血症(9.8%)、低钾血症(8.1%)、高钾血症(7.3%)和高钠血症(0.8%)。胃肠道受累表现为腹泻(11%)和呕吐(9%)。神经系统问题包括癫痫发作(18%)和意识水平改变(8%)。心血管表现包括心肌炎(11%)、杂音(9%)和心动过速(1%)。平均住院时间为6.2±3.7天。与无心脏受累的患者(5.8±3.0 天;p=0.020)相比,有心脏症状(包括心动过速(9.14±6.6 天)、杂音(6.18±3.0 天)和心肌炎(7.0±0.0 天)的患者)的平均住院时间明显更长。然而,胃肠道(p=0.127)和神经系统表现(p=0.127)患者的住院时间没有显着差异。在严重程度分层分析中,59.6%的病房患者和70.6%的HDU/ICU患者出现任何肺外表现(p=0.302);没有哪个系统显示两组之间存在统计学上的显着差异。在 6 例死亡病例中,50% 的患者患有相关的代谢紊乱。结论:RSV 毛细支气管炎 表现出 PCR 确诊的 RSV 毛细支气管炎 住院儿童的多系统受累,且不限于需要 HDU/ICU 护理的患者。心血管受累与较长的住院时间相关,而个体肺外系统的严重程度没有统计学上的显着差异。早期识别这些肺外表现对于改善临床结果和优化 治疗 至关重要。

title: Nine-Year Surveillance of Respiratory Syncytial Virus Epidemiology in Canada: Seasonal Patterns from 2016 to 2025
abstract: Understanding the epidemiological characteristics of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevalence is essential for developing effective public health interventions.This observational study analyzed 5,666 687 RSV surveillance records from Canada (WHO Global Influenza Programme, 2016-2025).Weekly and annual positivity rates were computed, and nine-year trends were visualized.Seasonal metrics including onset week, peak week, offset week and epidemic duration were quantified for each RSV season.In the pre-pandemic period (2016-2017 to 2019-2020), RSV seasonality varied annually in intensity and timing.The COVID-19 pandemic substantially disrupted RSV circulation: the 2020-2021 season yielded a positivity rate of 0.08% without a defined epidemic season, while 2021-2022 presented two waves with the earliest onset (week 33) and longest duration (29 weeks).For the post-non-pharmaceutical intervention (NPI) period (2023)(2024)(2024)(2025), RSV seasons showed earlier onset and offset with shorter durations.Although timing metrics shifted relative to pre-pandemic baselines, non-significant results should be interpreted cautiously owing to limited sample size of epidemic seasons.Aggregated pre-pandemic positivity (5.73%) was significantly higher than pandemic-era (4.85%) and post-NPI (3.98%) values.In conclusion, prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, RSV seasonality in Canada varied annually.The pandemic caused observable shifts in the onset, offset, and duration of RSV seasons.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 了解 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 患病率 的流行病学特征对于制定有效的公共卫生干预措施至关重要。这项观察性研究分析了来自加拿大的 5,666,687 条 RSV 监测 记录(世界卫生组织全球流感规划,2016-2025 年)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2016 年至 2025 年加拿大的 5,666,687 条 RSV 监测 记录,涵盖大流行前、大流行和大流行后时期。
elements_zh.methods: 计算每周和每年的阳性率,并可视化九年趋势。对每个 RSV 季节的季节性指标(包括发病周、高峰周、抵消周和流行持续时间)进行了量化。
elements_zh.main_results: 在大流行前时期(2016-2017年至2019-2020年),RSV季节性的强度和时间每年都在变化。COVID-19大流行严重扰乱了RSV的传播:2020-2021年季节的阳性率为0.08%,没有明确的流行季节,而2021-2022年则出现了两波,最早出现(第33周),持续时间最长(29周)。在 NPI 后时期(2023-2024 年至 2024-2025 年),RSV 季节出现较早,抵消时间较短。大流行前的聚合阳性率 (5.73%) 显着高于大流行时代 (4.85%) 和 NPI 后 (3.98%) 的值。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,在 COVID-19 大流行之前,加拿大的 RSV 季节性每年都在变化。这场大流行导致RSV季节的开始、抵消和持续时间发生了明显的变化。这些发现为了解大流行对 RSV 流行病学 的影响提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 监测、诊断 和 治疗 的 RSV 策略提供参考,特别是在未来大流行或类似干扰的情况下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管时间指标相对于大流行前的基线发生了变化,但由于流行季节的样本量有限,应谨慎解释不显着的结果。

title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus–Related Pediatric Intensive Care Unit Admissions in Children During Their Second RSV Season
abstract: Importance: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hospitalization rates are highest among children younger than 2 years. For certain high-risk children entering their second RSV season, the monoclonal antibody nirsevimab is recommended. Little is known regarding preexisting health conditions as risk factors for RSV-related respiratory failure in children during their second RSV season. Objective: To describe children admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) for severe RSV by classifying them by their nirsevimab eligibility status and preexisting health conditions, and comparing their demographic and clinical characteristics. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cohort study analyzed US children aged 8 to 23 months admitted to the PICU in 30 pediatric hospitals in the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 RSV seasons. All children had an RSV-positive result from a respiratory sample and received respiratory support with high-flow nasal cannula, noninvasive ventilation, or invasive mechanical ventilation. Analyses were based on the US criteria for second-season nirsevimab eligibility as recommended in August 2023. Exposure: Preexisting health conditions potentially associated with increased risk of severe RSV disease. Patients were classified into 4 mutually exclusive groups of eligibility status and preexisting health conditions: (1) met nirsevimab eligibility criteria, (2) with other identified RSV risk conditions (with some evidence of increased risk for severe RSV), (3) with other preexisting conditions, and (4) with no preexisting conditions. Main Outcomes and Measures: Patient demographic characteristics and level of respiratory support received were compared by level of preexisting health conditions. Results: A total of 574 children (median [IQR] age, 1.2 [1.1-1.5] years; 317 males [55.2%]) were included. Overall, 47 patients (8.2%) met the nirsevimab eligibility criteria, 76 (13.2%) had other identified RSV risk conditions, 96 (16.7%) had other preexisting conditions, and 355 (61.8%) had no preexisting conditions. A higher proportion of children who met nirsevimab eligibility criteria required invasive mechanical ventilation vs children with other identified RSV risk conditions, those with other preexisting health conditions, or those with no preexisting health conditions (40.4% [19 of 47] vs 17.1% [13 of 76], 10.4% [10 of 96], 5.9% [21 of 355]; P for trend <.001). Conclusions and Relevance: Among children admitted to the PICU for severe RSV, 8.2% met the nirsevimab eligibility criteria and 13.2% had other identified RSV risk conditions. These findings might help inform future deliberations regarding second RSV season recommendations for nirsevimab eligibility in the US.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the knowledge gap regarding preexisting health conditions as risk factors for RSV-related respiratory failure in children during their second RSV season, as RSV hospitalization rates are highest among children younger than 2 years.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This cohort study analyzed US children aged 8 to 23 months admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) in 30 pediatric hospitals during the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 RSV seasons.
analysis.methods: The study classified patients into four groups based on nirsevimab eligibility status and preexisting health conditions, and compared their demographic and clinical characteristics using the US criteria for second-season nirsevimab eligibility as recommended in August 2023.
analysis.main_results: A total of 574 children were included, with 47 (8.2%) meeting nirsevimab eligibility criteria, 76 (13.2%) having other identified RSV risk conditions, 96 (16.7%) having other preexisting conditions, and 355 (61.8%) having no preexisting conditions. A higher proportion of children who met nirsevimab eligibility criteria required invasive mechanical ventilation compared to other groups (40.4% vs 17.1%, 10.4%, and 5.9%, respectively; P for trend <.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that children meeting nirsevimab eligibility criteria are at a higher risk of requiring invasive mechanical ventilation for severe RSV, which may inform future deliberations on eligibility criteria for nirsevimab in the US.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results could help refine the understanding of risk factors for severe RSV in high-risk children, potentially guiding targeted interventions and improving clinical decision-making for nirsevimab use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a specific age group and geographic region, and the evidence is based on US criteria for nirsevimab eligibility. The confidence in these findings is moderate due to the potential for regional variability in RSV severity and treatment practices.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the risk factors for severe respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease in children during their second RSV season, focusing on preexisting health conditions and nirsevimab eligibility. It analyzed 574 children aged 8 to 23 months admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) in 30 US hospitals during the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 RSV seasons. Children meeting nirsevimab eligibility criteria were more likely to require invasive mechanical ventilation compared to those with other risk conditions or no preexisting conditions. The findings may inform future discussions on eligibility for nirsevimab in the US. However, the study's geographic and demographic focus limits its generalizability, and the evidence is based on US-specific criteria, resulting in moderate confidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决关于先前存在的健康状况作为儿童在第二个 RSV 季节期间与 RSV 相关的呼吸衰竭危险因素的知识差距,因为 RSV 住院率在 2 岁以下儿童中最高。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项 队列研究 研究分析了 2023 年至 2024 年和 2024 年至 2025 年 RSV 季节期间入住 30 家儿科医院儿科重症监护室 (PICU) 的 8 至 23 个月大的美国儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究根据 尼塞韦单抗 资格状况和既往健康状况将患者分为四组,并使用 2023 年 8 月建议的美国第二季 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准比较了他们的人口统计和临床特征。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the knowledge gap regarding preexisting health conditions as risk factors for RSV-related respiratory failure in children during their second RSV season, as RSV hospitalization rates are highest among children younger than 2 years.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This cohort study analyzed US children aged 8 to 23 months admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) in 30 pediatric hospitals during the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 RSV seasons.
analysis_en.methods: The study classified patients into four groups based on nirsevimab eligibility status and preexisting health conditions, and compared their demographic and clinical characteristics using the US criteria for second-season nirsevimab eligibility as recommended in August 2023.
analysis_en.main_results: A total of 574 children were included, with 47 (8.2%) meeting nirsevimab eligibility criteria, 76 (13.2%) having other identified RSV risk conditions, 96 (16.7%) having other preexisting conditions, and 355 (61.8%) having no preexisting conditions. A higher proportion of children who met nirsevimab eligibility criteria required invasive mechanical ventilation compared to other groups (40.4% vs 17.1%, 10.4%, and 5.9%, respectively; P for trend <.001).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that children meeting nirsevimab eligibility criteria are at a higher risk of requiring invasive mechanical ventilation for severe RSV, which may inform future deliberations on eligibility criteria for nirsevimab in the US.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results could help refine the understanding of risk factors for severe RSV in high-risk children, potentially guiding targeted interventions and improving clinical decision-making for nirsevimab use.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a specific age group and geographic region, and the evidence is based on US criteria for nirsevimab eligibility. The confidence in these findings is moderate due to the potential for regional variability in RSV severity and treatment practices.

title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒——第二个 RSV 季节期间儿童重症监护病房入院的相关儿童
source_body_en: Importance: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hospitalization rates are highest among children younger than 2 years. For certain high-risk children entering their second RSV season, the monoclonal antibody nirsevimab is recommended. Little is known regarding preexisting health conditions as risk factors for RSV-related respiratory failure in children during their second RSV season. Objective: To describe children admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) for severe RSV by classifying them by their nirsevimab eligibility status and preexisting health conditions, and comparing their demographic and clinical characteristics. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cohort study analyzed US children aged 8 to 23 months admitted to the PICU in 30 pediatric hospitals in the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 RSV seasons. All children had an RSV-positive result from a respiratory sample and received respiratory support with high-flow nasal cannula, noninvasive ventilation, or invasive mechanical ventilation. Analyses were based on the US criteria for second-season nirsevimab eligibility as recommended in August 2023. Exposure: Preexisting health conditions potentially associated with increased risk of severe RSV disease. Patients were classified into 4 mutually exclusive groups of eligibility status and preexisting health conditions: (1) met nirsevimab eligibility criteria, (2) with other identified RSV risk conditions (with some evidence of increased risk for severe RSV), (3) with other preexisting conditions, and (4) with no preexisting conditions. Main Outcomes and Measures: Patient demographic characteristics and level of respiratory support received were compared by level of preexisting health conditions. Results: A total of 574 children (median [IQR] age, 1.2 [1.1-1.5] years; 317 males [55.2%]) were included. Overall, 47 patients (8.2%) met the nirsevimab eligibility criteria, 76 (13.2%) had other identified RSV risk conditions, 96 (16.7%) had other preexisting conditions, and 355 (61.8%) had no preexisting conditions. A higher proportion of children who met nirsevimab eligibility criteria required invasive mechanical ventilation vs children with other identified RSV risk conditions, those with other preexisting health conditions, or those with no preexisting health conditions (40.4% [19 of 47] vs 17.1% [13 of 76], 10.4% [10 of 96], 5.9% [21 of 355]; P for trend <.001). Conclusions and Relevance: Among children admitted to the PICU for severe RSV, 8.2% met the nirsevimab eligibility criteria and 13.2% had other identified RSV risk conditions. These findings might help inform future deliberations regarding second RSV season recommendations for nirsevimab eligibility in the US.
abstract_zh: 重要性:呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 住院率在 2 岁以下儿童中最高。对于进入第二个 RSV 季节的某些高危儿童,建议使用单克隆抗体 尼塞韦单抗。对于儿童在第二个 RSV 季节期间与 RSV 相关的呼吸衰竭的危险因素,人们对先前存在的健康状况知之甚少。目的:通过按 尼塞韦单抗 资格状态和既往健康状况对儿童进行分类,并比较他们的人口学和临床特征,描述因严重 RSV 入住儿科重症监护病房 (PICU) 的儿童。设计、设置和参与者:这项 队列研究 研究分析了 2023 年至 2024 年和 2024 年至 2025 年 RSV 季节入住 30 家儿科医院 PICU 的 8 至 23 个月大的美国儿童。所有儿童的呼吸道样本均呈 RSV 阳性,并接受高流量鼻插管、无创通气或有创机械通气的呼吸支持。分析基于 2023 年 8 月建议的美国第二季 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准。暴露:先前存在的健康状况可能与严重 RSV 疾病风险增加相关。患者被分为 4 个相互排斥的资格状态和既往健康状况组:(1) 符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准,(2) 具有其他已确定的 RSV 风险状况(有一些证据表明严重 RSV 风险增加),(3) 具有其他既往状况,(4) 没有既往状况。主要结果和措施:根据既往健康状况水平对患者人口特征和接受的呼吸支持水平进行比较。结果:总共纳入 574 名儿童(中位 [IQR] 年龄,1.2 [1.1-1.5] 岁;317 名男性 [55.2%])。总体而言,47 名患者 (8.2%) 符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准,76 名患者 (13.2%) 患有其他已确定的 RSV 风险状况,96 名患者 (16.7%) 患有其他既往病史,355 名患者 (61.8%) 没有既往病史。符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准的儿童需要有创机械通气的比例高于患有其他已确定的 RSV 风险状况的儿童、具有其他既往健康状况或没有既往健康状况的儿童(40.4% [47 名中的 19 名] vs 17.1% [76 名中的 13 名]、10.4% [96 名中的 10 名]、5.9% [355 名中的 21 名];P 代表趋势<.001)。结论和相关性:在因严重 RSV 入住 PICU 的儿童中,8.2% 符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格标准,13.2% 具有其他已确定的 RSV 风险状况。这些发现可能有助于为未来关于美国 尼塞韦单抗 资格的 RSV 第二季建议的审议提供信息。

title: Research Trends in Respiratory Syncytial Virus: A Ten-Year Bibliometric Analysis and the Translational Evolution of Dual Strategies for Prevention
abstract: Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) has always been a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections in vulnerable age groups since its identification in 1956. Despite more than half a century of attempts, the effective preventive strategies only arrived recently with the approval of the prefusion F protein–based vaccines and the long-acting monoclonal antibodies. A full understanding of how RSV research has changed with the prefusion F protein–based vaccines and the acting monoclonal antibodies helps us see the road of RSV prevention and helps us guide the future prevention steps. Methods: We conducted an analysis of RSV related publications, in the Web of Science Core Collection from 2014 to 2025. The analysis combined citation analysis, collaboration networks, keyword evolution and co citation mapping. In parallel, trials of the RSV monoclonal antibodies and the vaccines that are listed on ClinicalTrials.gov were examined, time span focusing on the studies that started or finished after the milestones. The combined approach linked the research trends to the progress, in the RSV prevention. Results: There were 2,670 publications that were part of the study and what we found out is that people are doing more research on RSV especially after 2019. The United States and China emerged as the most influential contributors, supported by dense international collaboration networks. Keyword and co-citation analyses showed a shift, from virology and disease burden studies to prevention-focused themes. Prevention-focused themes include prefusion F antigen design, monoclonal antibodies, vaccination and hospitalization outcomes. Clinical trial analysis showed that long-acting monoclonal antibodies(especially nirsevimab) have led infant RSV prophylaxis since their development, while recombinant prefusion F protein vaccines make up the majority of vaccine trials, sponsored primarily by major pharmaceutical developers. mRNA, live-attenuated viral vector, and virus-like particle platforms, although not widely used, remain strategically important for generating new approaches. Conclusions: RSV prevention has entered a novel phase which characterized by the convergence of long-acting monoclonal antibodies for infants and effective vaccines for older adults and pregnant women. The integration of bibliometric trends with clinical trial landscapes highlights a transition from exploratory research to implementation-oriented prevention strategies. Future efforts must pay attention to low- and middle-income countries where RSV burden stays highest.

title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒的研究趋势:十年文献计量分析和双重预防策略的转化进化
source_body_en: Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) has always been a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections in vulnerable age groups since its identification in 1956. Despite more than half a century of attempts, the effective preventive strategies only arrived recently with the approval of the prefusion F protein–based vaccines and the long-acting monoclonal antibodies. A full understanding of how RSV research has changed with the prefusion F protein–based vaccines and the acting monoclonal antibodies helps us see the road of RSV prevention and helps us guide the future prevention steps. Methods: We conducted an analysis of RSV related publications, in the Web of Science Core Collection from 2014 to 2025. The analysis combined citation analysis, collaboration networks, keyword evolution and co citation mapping. In parallel, trials of the RSV monoclonal antibodies and the vaccines that are listed on ClinicalTrials.gov were examined, time span focusing on the studies that started or finished after the milestones. The combined approach linked the research trends to the progress, in the RSV prevention. Results: There were 2,670 publications that were part of the study and what we found out is that people are doing more research on RSV especially after 2019. The United States and China emerged as the most influential contributors, supported by dense international collaboration networks. Keyword and co-citation analyses showed a shift, from virology and disease burden studies to prevention-focused themes. Prevention-focused themes include prefusion F antigen design, monoclonal antibodies, vaccination and hospitalization outcomes. Clinical trial analysis showed that long-acting monoclonal antibodies(especially nirsevimab) have led infant RSV prophylaxis since their development, while recombinant prefusion F protein vaccines make up the majority of vaccine trials, sponsored primarily by major pharmaceutical developers. mRNA, live-attenuated viral vector, and virus-like particle platforms, although not widely used, remain strategically important for generating new approaches. Conclusions: RSV prevention has entered a novel phase which characterized by the convergence of long-acting monoclonal antibodies for infants and effective vaccines for older adults and pregnant women. The integration of bibliometric trends with clinical trial landscapes highlights a transition from exploratory research to implementation-oriented prevention strategies. Future efforts must pay attention to low- and middle-income countries where RSV burden stays highest.
abstract_zh: 背景:自 1956 年发现以来,呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 一直是易感人群急性下呼吸道感染的主要原因。尽管进行了半个多世纪的尝试,但直到最近基于预输 F 蛋白的 疫苗 和长效单克隆抗体的批准,有效的预防策略才得以实现。充分了解基于预灌F蛋白的疫苗和作用单克隆抗体如何改变RSV研究,有助于我们看到RSV预防之路,并帮助我们指导未来的预防步骤。方法:我们对 2014 年至 2025 年 Web of Science 核心合集中 RSV 相关出版物进行了分析。该分析结合了引文分析、协作网络、关键词 进化 和共引映射。与此同时,对 ClinicalTrials.gov 上列出的 RSV 单克隆抗体和 疫苗 的试验进行了检查,时间跨度重点关注在里程碑之后开始或完成的研究。这种综合方法将研究趋势与 RSV 预防的进展联系起来。结果:该研究中有 2,670 篇出版物,我们发现人们对 RSV 进行了更多研究,尤其是在 2019 年之后。在密集的国际合作网络的支持下,美国和中国成为最有影响力的贡献者。关键词和同被引分析表明,从病毒学和疾病负担研究转向以预防为重点的主题。以预防为重点的主题包括输注前 F 抗原设计、单克隆抗体、疫苗接种 和住院结果。临床试验分析表明,长效单克隆抗体(尤其是 尼塞韦单抗)自开发以来一直引领婴儿 RSV 预防,而重组预融合 F 蛋白 疫苗 占 疫苗 试验的大部分,主要由主要药物开发商赞助。mRNA、减毒活病毒 媒介 和病毒样颗粒平台虽然没有广泛使用,但对于产生新方法仍然具有重要的战略意义。结论:RSV预防已进入一个新阶段,其特点是婴儿长效单克隆抗体和老年人和孕妇有效的疫苗的融合。文献计量趋势与临床试验格局的整合凸显了从探索性研究到以实施为导向的预防策略的转变。未来的努力必须关注 RSV 负担仍然最高的低收入和中等收入国家。

title: Real-world impact and effectiveness of universal respiratory syncytial virus vaccination during pregnancy on infant hospitalisations in Buenos Aires: a multicentre retrospective cohort study across two consecutive seasons (2024–2025)
abstract: Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of severe acute lower respiratory tract infection (ALRTI) in young infants. Argentina implemented seasonal universal RSVpreF maternal vaccination (RSVpreF-MV) in 2024, extending the vaccination window in 2025. Nationwide coverage reached 67.8% in 2024 and 74.0% in 2025. We evaluated the real-world impact and effectiveness (VE) of this strategy over two consecutive seasons. Methods We conducted a multicentre, hospital-based, retrospective surveillance study in four tertiary paediatric hospitals in Buenos Aires (2018–2025). Population-level impact was assessed for each vaccination season by comparing observed RSV-hospitalisations among infants ≤6 months with expected numbers from pre-implementation years (2018, 2019, and 2023). VE was estimated using a nested test-negative case–control design among infants hospitalised with ALRTI whose mothers were eligible for RSVpreF-MV. Findings An estimated 130.2 (95% CI 109.4–151.6) RSV-related hospitalisations were averted in 2024 and 263.8 (95% CI 238.9–288.9) in 2025 among infants aged ≤6 months, a 24.8 percentage-point (95% CI 23.5–26.3) greater relative reduction in 2025 (59.7%, 95% CI 57.3–61.9) compared with 2024 (34.9%, 95% CI 31.0–38.4), driven primarily by a decline in disease burden among infants aged 0–3 months. The number needed to immunise to prevent one hospitalisation in 2025 was 36.4 (95% CI 30.7–54.9). In pooled analyses of the 2024–2025 seasons, adjusted-VE against RSV-related hospitalisation was 73.7% (95% CI 58.3–83.6) for infants aged ≤6 months and 78.5% (95% CI 60.9–88.5) for those ≤3 months. Among infants ≤6 months, VE was 75.3% (95% CI 39.1–90.4) against RSV-related PICU admission. Interpretation During 2025, when the vaccination window was extended by four months, population-level impact was greater, with protection extending beyond the first 6 months of life. Funding Thrasher Research Fund (Early Career Award #02398) and the Gates Foundation (INV-03673107).

We evaluated the real-world impact and effectiveness (VE) of this strategy over two consecutive seasons. Methods We conducted a multicentre, hospital-based, retrospective surveillance study in four tertiary paediatric hospitals in Buenos Aires (2018–2025). Population-level impact was assessed for each vaccination season by comparing observed RSV-hospitalisations among infants ≤6 months with expected numbers from pre-implementation years (2018, 2019, and 2023). VE was estimated using a nested test-negative case–control design among infants hospitalised with ALRTI whose mothers were eligible for RSVpreF-MV. Findings An estimated 130.2 (95% CI 109.4–151.6) RSV-related hospitalisations were averted in 2024 and 263.8 (95% CI 238.9–288.9) in 2025 among infants aged ≤6 months, a 24.8 percentage-point (95% CI 23.5–26.3) greater relative reduction in 2025 (59.7%, 95% CI 57.3–61.9) compared with 2024 (34.9%, 95% CI 31.0–38.4), driven primarily by a decline in disease burden among infants aged 0–3 months. The number needed to immunise to prevent one hospitalisation in 2025 was 36.4 (95% CI 30.7–54.9). In pooled analyses of the 2024–2025 seasons, adjusted-VE against RSV-related hospitalisation was 73.7% (95% CI 58.3–83.6) for infants aged ≤6 months and 78.5% (95% CI 60.9–88.5) for those ≤3 months. Among infants ≤6 months, VE was 75.3% (95% CI 39.1–90.4) against RSV-related PICU admission. Interpretation During 2025, when the vaccination window was extended by four months, population-level impact was greater, with protection extending beyond the first 6 months of life. Funding Thrasher Research Fund (Early Career Award #02398) and the Gates Foundation (INV-03673107).

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the real-world impact and effectiveness of universal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination during pregnancy in Buenos Aires over two consecutive seasons (2024–2025). The research highlights that RSVpreF maternal vaccination significantly reduced RSV-related hospitalisations among infants aged ≤6 months, with a greater reduction observed in 2025 when the vaccination window was extended by four months. The study, conducted in four tertiary paediatric hospitals, used a nested test-negative case–control design to estimate vaccine effectiveness (VE). The findings suggest that extending the vaccination period could improve protection beyond the first six months of life. However, the study's retrospective nature may limit its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate due to potential biases and confounding factors.

abstract_zh: 背景 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是小婴儿严重急性下呼吸道感染 (ALRTI) 的主要原因。阿根廷于 2024 年实施了季节性通用 RSVpreF 孕产妇 疫苗接种 (RSVpreF-MV),并于 2025 年延长了 疫苗接种 窗口。全国覆盖率于 2024 年达到 67.8%,2025 年达到 74.0%。我们连续两个季节评估了该策略的实际影响和有效性 (VE)。方法 我们在布宜诺斯艾利斯的四家三级儿科医院(2018-2025)进行了一项多中心、以医院为基础的回顾性 监测 研究。通过将观察到的 ≤6 个月婴儿 RSV 住院率与实施前年份(2018 年、2019 年和 2023 年)的预期数字进行比较,评估了每个 疫苗接种 季节的人口水平影响。使用巢式测试阴性病例对照设计对因 ALRTI 住院且其母亲符合 RSVpreF-MV 条件的婴儿进行 VE 估计。研究结果 估计 2024 年和 2025 年 6 个月以下婴儿中避免了 130.2 例(95% CI 109.4–151.6)RSV 相关住院治疗,2025 年避免了 263.8 例(95% CI 238.9–288.9)例,相对减少了 24.8 个百分点(95% CI 23.5–26.3)。2025 年(59.7%,95% CI 57.3-61.9)与 2024 年(34.9%,95% CI 31.0-38.4)相比,主要是由于 0-3 个月婴儿疾病负担下降。2025 年,为预防 1 次住院而需要进行免疫接种的人数为 36.4 人(95% CI 30.7-54.9)。在 2024-2025 年季节的汇总分析中,≤6 个月婴儿的 RSV 相关住院调整后 VE 为 73.7%(95% CI 58.3-83.6),≤ 3 个月婴儿为 78.5%(95% CI 60.9-88.5)。在 ≤ 6 个月的婴儿中,与 RSV 相关的 PICU 入院相比,VE 为 75.3% (95% CI 39.1–90.4)。解读 2025 年,疫苗接种 窗口期延长了四个月,人口层面的影响更大,保护范围延伸到生命前 6 个月之后。资助 Thrasher 研究基金(早期职业奖#02398)和盖茨基金会(INV-03673107)。

title: Country-specific disease burden of respiratory syncytial virus in children younger than five years in low- and middle-income countrie: a modelling study
abstract: Abstract Country-level estimates of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) burden are scarce in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), particularly for hospital admissions and deaths. We modelled country- and age-specific RSV-associated acute lower respiratory infection (ALRI) incidence and hospital admission rates, and RSV-attributable and RSV-associated all-cause mortality rates, among children under five across 135 LMICs. RSV-associated ALRI incidence ranged from 38.9 to 80.5 per 1,000 person-years and was highest in southern Africa (Botswana, South Africa and Eswatini). RSV-associated ALRI hospital admission rates ranged from 0.8 to 23.2 per 1,000 person-years and were highest in the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, Tajikistan and Ukraine. RSV-attributable and RSV-associated mortality rates ranged from 0.5 to 52.9 and from 1.1 to 120.9 per 100,000 person-years, respectively, with the highest rates in sub-Saharan Africa, including Nigeria, Somalia and Chad. These comparable estimates help fill country-level evidence gaps and can inform equitable prioritisation of RSV immunisation.

title: Pathogens associated with childhood febrile illness in West Africa: a systematic review
abstract: Background Up to 80% of children seeking medical attention in Africa present with acute febrile illness. Epidemiological data on the locally circulating pathogens causing fever are essential to inform clinical management and for public health interventions. This systematic review sought to understand the aetiologies of febrile illness among children in West Africa. Methods We included healthcare facility and community-based studies with cross-sectional, case-control, and retrospective cross-sectional design which used laboratory methods to detect pathogens causing fever in children aged 1 month to 15 years. A literature search was conducted in Medline and Embase via OVID, Scopus, ScienceDirect, Connecting Repositories (CoRE), Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ), African Journals Online (AJOL) and World Health Organisation (WHO) Africa Index Medicus, for studies published from 2013 to 2023. Data was extracted on pathogens detected from routine clinical investigations and study-specific laboratory testing. A risk of bias assessment was conducted using a consolidated CASP checklist developed from the case-control and cross-sectional study checklists. Results We included 84 studies from 11 West African countries. 42% of studies investigated bacterial pathogens in blood, 24% in respiratory samples and 19% in urine, stool, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and ear swabs combined, resulting in the detection of 25 different bacterial species. The most common of these were Salmonella enterica, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, Haemophilus influenzae , and Escherichia coli . Seventeen different viruses were detected. Dengue virus, chikungunya virus and West Nile virus were mostly detected from serological studies. Influenza viruses, rhinoviruses, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), parainfluenza viruses, human metapneumovirus, coronaviruses, adenoviruses, and enteroviruses were commonly isolated from respiratory samples. Plasmodium falciparum was the most abundant parasite of the 5 different parasites/fungal species detected. Only 8% of studies performed comprehensive investigations (concurrent testing across ≥ 3 pathogen classes in the same participant) for a wide range of pathogens. Conclusion This study found that diagnostic testing was predominantly blood-based, with limited investigation of gastrointestinal, zoonotic, and emerging pathogens. These findings reveal important gaps in the existing evidence base for febrile pathogen detection and highlight areas where future primary research with a broader diagnostic scope would provide more complete epidemiological data. This systematic review has been registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO) under the registration number: CRD 42023466517. Clinical trials registration Not applicable

abstract_zh: 背景 在非洲就医的儿童中,高达 80% 患有急性发热性疾病。有关当地传播的发烧病原体的流行病学数据对于临床管理和公共卫生干预至关重要。这项系统评价旨在了解西非儿童发热性疾病的病因。方法 我们纳入了医疗机构和社区研究,采用横断面、病例对照和回顾性横断面设计,使用实验室方法检测引起 1 个月至 15 岁儿童发烧的病原体。通过 OVID、Scopus、ScienceDirect、Connecting Repositories (CoRE)、Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ)、African Journals Online (AJOL) 和世界卫生组织 (WHO) Africa Index Medicus 在 Medline 和 Embase 上进行了文献检索,检索 2013 年至 2023 年发表的研究。数据是从常规临床调查和特定研究实验室测试中检测到的病原体中提取的。使用根据病例对照和横断面研究清单开发的综合 CASP 清单进行偏倚风险评估。结果 我们纳入了来自 11 个西非国家的 84 项研究。42% 的研究调查了血液中的细菌病原体,24% 的研究调查了呼吸道样本中的细菌病原体,19% 的研究调查了尿液、粪便、脑脊液 (CSF) 和耳拭子中的细菌病原体,最终检测到了 25 种不同的细菌。其中最常见的是肠道沙门氏菌、肺炎链球菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、流感嗜血杆菌和大肠杆菌。检测到十七种不同的病毒。登革热病毒、基孔肯雅病毒和西尼罗河病毒主要是通过血清学研究检测到的。通常从呼吸道样本中分离出流感病毒、鼻病毒、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV)、副流感病毒、人类偏肺病毒、冠状病毒、腺病毒和肠道病毒。恶性疟原虫是检测到的 5 种不同寄生虫/真菌物种中最丰富的寄生虫。只有 8% 的研究对多种病原体进行了全面调查(同一参与者同时测试 ≥ 3 种病原体类别)。结论 这项研究发现诊断检测主要以血液为基础,对胃肠道、人畜共患和新出现的病原体的研究有限。这些发现揭示了发热病原体检测的现有证据基础中的重要差距,并强调了未来具有更广泛诊断范围的初级研究将提供更完整的流行病学数据的领域。该系统评价已在国际前瞻性系统评价注册库(PROSPERO)中注册,注册号:CRD 42023466517。临床试验注册 不适用

title: Post-authorization safety surveillance of RSV vaccinated U.S. pregnant women reporting to V-safe
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of US infant hospitalizations. In 2023, the Food and Drug Administration approved an RSV vaccine (Pfizer, Abrysvo) for administration to pregnant women to prevent severe RSV disease in their infants. V-safe collects information about events experienced shortly after vaccination. Vaccinated women who enrolled in V-safe completed web-based surveys about injection site and systemic reactions, their severity, and health impacts (i.e., interference with normal daily activities, missing work or school, or receipt of healthcare) daily for 7 days and then weekly during weeks 2-6 post-vaccination. During October 12, 2023-March 21, 2025, 1200 pregnant women reported RSV vaccination and completed at least one health survey. Median age was 34 years. Common symptoms reported on 0-7 days post-vaccination surveys included injection site pain (32.5%), fatigue (27.7%), and muscle aches (20.5%). Reactions were most frequently reported the first day post-vaccination, and most were self-categorized as mild or moderate. A health impact was reported by 12.5% of participants during the first week after vaccination. Preterm delivery was reported by 59 (6.1%) of 971 participants vaccinated 32-36 weeks of gestation who provided a delivery date. In clinical trials, 5.7% of vaccinated women had preterm delivery. However, more V-safe participants had risk factors for preterm delivery. Based on reports from vaccinated women, short term reactogenicity of mild or moderate severity was common after maternal RSV vaccination. Our findings were generally consistent with safety data from pre-licensure randomized clinical trials of RSV vaccines administered to pregnant women.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the safety of RSV vaccines administered to pregnant women in the United States through the V-safe system. It highlights that RSV is the leading cause of infant hospitalizations in the US, and the vaccine was approved in 2023 to prevent severe RSV disease in infants. The study reports that common short-term reactions after vaccination include injection site pain, fatigue, and muscle aches, with most reactions categorized as mild or moderate. A health impact was reported by 12.5% of participants during the first week post-vaccination. Preterm delivery was reported in 6.1% of vaccinated women, which is slightly higher than the 5.7% observed in clinical trials. However, the study notes that more V-safe participants had risk factors for preterm delivery. The findings align with pre-licensure safety data from clinical trials. The review underscores the importance of continued safety monitoring and highlights the need for further research on long-term outcomes and the impact of risk factors on preterm delivery rates.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是美国婴儿住院的主要原因。此次审查的重点是通过 V-safe 系统向美国孕妇施用 RSV 疫苗 的安全性 监测。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2023 年,美国食品和药物管理局批准了 RSV 疫苗(辉瑞、Abrysvo)用于孕妇给药,以预防婴儿患严重 RSV 疾病。参加 V-safe 的疫苗接种女性在 7 天内每天完成一次关于注射部位和全身反应、其严重程度和健康影响(即干扰正常日常活动、缺勤或缺课或接受医疗保健)的网络调查,然后在 疫苗接种 后的 2-6 周内每周完成一次。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 2023年10月12日至2025年3月21日期间,1200名孕妇报告了RSV 疫苗接种,并完成了至少一项健康调查。疫苗接种 调查后 0-7 天报告的常见症状包括注射部位疼痛 (32.5%)、疲劳 (27.7%) 和肌肉疼痛 (20.5%)。疫苗接种 后第一天最常报告反应,大多数自我归类为轻度或中度。12.5% 的参与者报告 疫苗接种 后第一周内对健康产生了影响。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 971 名在妊娠 32-36 周接种疫苗并提供分娩日期的参与者中有 59 名 (6.1%) 报告早产。在临床试验中,5.7% 的接种疫苗的妇女出现早产。然而,更多 V-safe 参与者有早产的危险因素。我们的研究结果与对孕妇施用 RSV 疫苗 的许可前随机临床试验的安全性数据基本一致。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 根据接种疫苗的妇女的报告,母体 RSV 疫苗接种 后出现轻度或中度严重程度的短期反应原性很常见。

title: RSV prevention after nirsevimab: what Europe has learned-and what it has not.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Europe moved within two seasons from selective respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prophylaxis for a small high-risk group to population-based strategies capable of protecting most infants. We aimed to examine the European experience with RSV prevention after nirsevimab introduction, and identify key lessons regarding implementation, programme performance, comparative evaluation, and remaining evidence gaps. Studies evaluating RSV prevention after nirsevimab introduction in Europe were searched. Evidence was mapped according to implementation strategies, effectiveness outcomes, healthcare impact, safety, resistance, and emerging research questions. Real-world studies from Europe consistently reported considerable reductions in RSV hospitalisation and intensive-care admission following nirsevimab implementation. Heterogeneity in programme design and delivery suggests that product effectiveness is only one determinant of impact: programme characteristics like administration timing, catch-up strategies, coverage, maternity-versus-community delivery, and the age distribution of baseline burden influence observed outcomes. Second-season evidence distinguishes limited residual individual protection from a persisting cumulative two-season benefit. Maternal RSVpreF vaccination is highly effective when administered sufficiently before delivery, although cross-strategy comparisons remain vulnerable to timing and selection bias. Safety findings remain reassuring; resistance-associated substitutions are detectable but have not undermined population-level effectiveness. The recent introduction of clesrovimab further expands preventive options. CONCLUSION: Europe has answered whether universal infant RSV prevention can reduce severe disease burden but not yet standardised how programmes are compared. The next phase should move from product advocacy to programme science: one primary strategy for most infants, explicit rescue indications, linked immunisation-outcome-genomic surveillance, common estimands and transparent measurement of equity and opportunity cost. WHAT IS KNOWN: • Long-acting monoclonal antibodies and maternal RSVpreF vaccination prevent severe RSV disease in early infancy. WHAT IS NEW: • The European lesson is not a universal product ranking: delivery architecture, catch-up and the interval between maternal vaccination and birth determine population impact. • Second-season policy requires estimand discipline: limited residual effectiveness can coexist with substantial cumulative two-season benefit and no rebound.
